title: Strategic KPI — AI-Powered Business Performance Platform
desc: Enterprise SaaS platform for KPI management, audits, AI insights, and business performance tracking.
fullDescription: Strategic KPI is a comprehensive enterprise SaaS platform designed to help organizations manage KPIs, audits, tasks, reports, and performance analytics from a centralized dashboard. The system supports multiple departments with role-based access, AI-powered insights, automated workflows, and real-time reporting to improve operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.
challenges: Designing a scalable multi-module enterprise architecture
Building reusable dashboard components for multiple business modules
Maintaining high performance with large datasets
Integrating AI-generated business insights into existing workflows
Ensuring maintainability across frontend and backend codebases
results: Built a production-ready enterprise SaaS platform capable of managing organizational performance, audits, and KPI tracking through a unified system. The platform significantly reduces manual reporting efforts, centralizes business operations, and provides actionable AI-driven insights for decision makers.
